a.lede: A jury found that Arm breached its agreement with Qualcomm and interfered with its business, but Arm only has to pay $2 in damages.
a.title: Qualcomm wins lawsuit against Arm but will only receive two bucks

b.lede: A federal jury sides with Arm on select issues, rules in favor of Qualcomm in other cases. The legal battle set to continue.
b.title: Qualcomm wins architecture breach verdict against Arm but gets just $2
